installCommand: (pip install -r requirements.txt --target Back/vendor || pip3 install -r requirements.txt --target Back/vendor || true) && (if [ -d 'Front' ]; then cd Front; fi && pnpm install --force)
buildCommand: (if [ -d 'Front' ]; then cd Front; fi && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4096' pnpm run build)
